name: APFSDS DM53 (Germany, 120 mm)
description: German 120 mm tank round (Leopard 2A6/2A7, L/55 gun). Tungsten-alloy rod about 685 mm long, 23 mm thick (5 kg); 1720 m/s from the L/55 gun, 1670 m/s from the shorter L/44. Public figures disagree (23 or 26 mm thick); 23 mm matches the stated 5 kg. DM63 uses the same rod. Fins and sabot are not modelled. Nose shape approximate.
